title: A studio for your working day
intro: Profile, media, calendar, messages and appointment requests live in one place, in the same interface as the marketplace.

trust.title: Trust cannot be bought
trust.text: Verified identity and verified photos appear as separate signals on your profile. A plan changes neither your verification nor your position in organic search. Paid placements always carry the word “Ad”.

control.title: You decide
control.text: You choose which region you show; an exact address is never published. You pause your profile with one click. Every appointment request is voluntary, and you can always cancel without giving a reason.

review.title: Checked before it is visible
review.text: Before a profile appears, age of majority and identity are verified and the profile is approved by hand. Identity documents are processed by a suitable provider; we store only the result, the time and the expiry.
